subject: Coord: Apollo Health demo — exec overlap, proposing staggered windows

Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coord: Apollo Health demo — exec overlap, proposing staggered windows

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call, we scheduled a 60-minute technical + product demo for next Thursday at 2:00pm PT. I wanted to confirm that still works for your team.

Quick notes: Marissa (SE) will cover integration patterns and performance; I (AE) will lead the business/ROI discussion. If the execs have a tight window, we can split into two shorter blocks (exec summary + technical deep-dive) — happy to propose options.

Attached is a draft agenda and a couple of slot alternatives in case you need to compress. Can you confirm preferred approach?

Attachments: [Attachment: Apollo-Agenda.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: Proposed-Availability.ics (Calendar invite stub)]

Thanks,
Jonas

From: Anna Kerr <anna.kerr@apollohealth.com>

Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@apollohealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coord: Apollo Health demo — exec overlap, proposing staggered windows

Hi Jonas —

Thanks — quick heads up: our SVP unexpectedly has a board prep that overlaps 2:00–2:45pm next Thursday and our engineering lead has an offsite. I still want the team to see Redwood, but we may not have a single 60-min contiguous window with all stakeholders.

Two ideas:
- Shorten to a 30-min exec-focused session that the SVP can join, and follow up with a separate 30-min technical deep-dive for the engineers (asynchronous recording ok).
- Or, move the full 60-min demo earlier in the day (we're tight between 9–11am PT).

Can you tell me if splitting into two focused sessions would work for you and whether sessions can be recorded?

Best,
Anna
Anna Kerr | Director of Product Strategy
Apollo Health
anna.kerr@apollohealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coord: Apollo Health demo — exec overlap, proposing staggered windows

Jonas — quick internal note.

I can split the content:
- 25–30 min executive summary focused on latency/cost/value (high level, no deep config).
- 30–35 min technical walkthrough (integration, dedicated vs hosted, quantization/latency tradeoffs).

Recording is fine — we should call out a short async follow-up playbook (20-min office hours) for any detailed infra questions. If we split, I can lead the technical block and Soojin can cover the exec/ordering details and cost examples in the first session to keep continuity.

Soojins calendar: soojin_lee@redwood.com — she has an open slot 9:30–10:00am PT and 10:30–11:00am PT next Thursday; I have a block 9:00–10:00am PT.

If we propose 9:30am (exec) + 10:00am (tech) we give them two compact windows and a short gap to stretch. Thoughts?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Solutions Engineer
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Anna Kerr <anna.kerr@apollohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@apollohealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coord: Apollo Health demo — exec overlap, proposing staggered windows

Anna / Raj —

Thanks for the context — splitting is feasible and probably the least disruptive. Proposed options (pick one):

A) Staggered compact windows (my preference):
- 09:30–09:55am PT — Executive summary + ROI (Soojin will lead, Jonas intro)
- 10:05–10:40am PT — Technical walkthrough (Marissa lead, recording enabled)

B) Single earlier block: 09:00–10:00am PT — full 60-min demo (Marissa + Jonas)

Notes:
- We'll record the technical session and share the recording + condensed playbook afterward.
- I attached the narrowed agenda and an .ics with the two-option slots so you can pick quickly.

If you confirm option A, I'll send two invites. If option B works, I'll replace the original 2pm invite.

Attachments: [Attachment: Apollo-Agenda.pdf], [Attachment: Proposed-Availability.ics]

Thanks,
Jonas

To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@apollohealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coord: Apollo Health demo — exec overlap, proposing staggered windows

Jonas —

Option A works well for us. Please send both invites — exec will join the 09:30 slot; engineers will join the 10:05 technical session. Recording the technical session is appreciated.

Also, could you include a one-pager that highlights integration checklists and example SLA numbers in the follow-up? That will help our procurement team after the exec summary.

Thanks,
Anna
